subquestions.question: What happens in decomposition?
subquestions.feedback: Decomposition splits a single reactant.

subquestions.question: What happens in double displacement?

options.text: One compound always splits by heat.

subquestions.incorrect_answer: One compound always splits by heat.
subquestions.feedback: Ions swap partners.

subquestions.question: Which is a decomposition example?
subquestions.feedback: One reactant produces two products.

subquestions.question: Which reaction forms a white precipitate?

Ions swap partners.
One reactant produces two products.
Barium sulphate is an insoluble white solid.
final_explanation.key_idea: Decomposition: one breaks. Double: two swap ions.
final_explanation.memory_tip: Remember: Decomposition: one breaks → Double: two swap ions.
